wizard_structure.summary: Vanilla JS IIFE that hijacks Vue's #item-variation-modal and replaces the inner body with a single-page (S25) composition wizard. The wizard NEVER builds composition_snapshot itself — that is server-side SSOT. The wizard's sole role is to populate Vue store state (variations/extras/addons + total) and dispatch a synthetic CustomEvent('wizard:add-to-cart') that the legacy Vue ItemComponent listens for.

entry_point.trigger: MutationObserver on document.body watches for #item-variation-modal mount/unmount (Vue Router SPA re-mount aware, ref pos-wizard.js:5923-5944)

globals: selections (the actual user choices, plain object)
state_machine.lifecycle: openWizard(modal) → buildSteps(data) → renderSinglePage() / renderWizard() → bindSinglePageEvents() → user clicks .add-to-cart → syncAndSubmit() → submitWhenSynced() → modalRoot.dispatchEvent('wizard:add-to-cart') → Vue ItemComponent.addToCart() → closeWizard(true)

data_capture.primary: XMLHttpRequest.prototype.send override (pos-wizard.js:184-196) intercepts /admin/item/* responses and stores data in lastItemData
data_capture.fallback_a: window.fetch override (pos-wizard.js:202+) for Vue axios fallback path
data_capture.fallback_b: modal.getAttribute('data-wizard-item-data') JSON injection from Vue edit-from-cart path (pos-wizard.js:4286-4296)
data_capture.concern: Three independent ingestion paths increase surface area but are all idempotent overwrites of lastItemData. Race is not observable because openWizard reads only after retry loop tryOpen() confirms presence (pos-wizard.js:5905-5913).

steps: 1. Mirror itemQuantity to qty input via native setter + bubbling events (pos-wizard.js:3711-3718)
2. Click sauce/variation radios to drive Vue v-model (pos-wizard.js:3720-3750)
3. Click pain radios (legacy sandwich) — supports both numeric IDs and string fallbacks (pos-wizard.js:3754-3774)
4. Check/uncheck extras checkboxes against allSelectedExtras map (pos-wizard.js:3820-3899) — includes crudités default-included logic
5. Build pos-line-addons payload for menu addons (sauce frites + grande portion + cheddar) and attach to modal via data-wizard-pos-line-addons (pos-wizard.js:4083-4223)
6. Set data-wizard-total (running total before submit), data-wizard-cart-display (multi-line summary)
submit_pipeline.concern_low: The chain depends on Vue radios/checkboxes being present in originalBody. If Vue mutates the DOM structure (e.g. catalog v15 refactor), the click-driven sync breaks silently. No explicit fallback; user sees empty extras on Vue side. Mitigated in practice by frozen state.

edit_from_cart_path.logic: When the wizard re-opens for cart edit, Vue injects data-wizard-restore-selections JSON; wizard parses and Object.assign into selections. Notable restores: instruction text (Y1), _cartQuantity (Y1), menu_restore branch (X4 boissonChoice, X5 viandeSupplItems). Risk = stale selection keys not present in current item data; mitigated by buildSteps() running BEFORE restore (A1 fix at line 4698).
edit_from_cart_path.concern_low: JSON.parse on attribute is wrapped in try/catch with console.warn; corrupted state degrades to default selections, no crash.

profile_mirror.summary: POS wizard is composer-aware via feature flag posWizardComposerAware.enabled (DEFAULT OFF, ref admin-pos-v4.blade.php:110-111). When enabled AND data.composer_profile is non-empty, the wizard delegates to buildStepsFromComposerProfile() instead of legacy buildSteps() heuristic.

data_path.frontend_consume: getComposerProfileFromData(data) at pos-wizard.js:442 reads data.composer_profile, validates Array.isArray(steps) && length > 0

step_normalization.defensive_seam_notes: [V2-WIZARD-RT-REFACTOR-XL Batch C] — malformed payloads degrade gracefully; if not object → null → skipped. Good practice.

type_resolution.fallback: If step_key+addon_role both unmatched but choices.length>0, internalType=generic_choices; else skip with console.warn (pos-wizard.js:513-524)
type_resolution.concern_low: Composer step types are tightly coupled to the legacy step_key vocabulary. Adding a new admin-configurable step type requires JS map update. V1.0.X backlog: convert to declarative table (e.g. data-driven renderers per step type).

visible_on_filter.rule: Empty visible_on array OR missing field → all surfaces; else 'pos' must be present

composition_snapshot_lifecycle.summary: The wizard does NOT build composition_snapshot. Snapshot is built backend-side by CompositionSnapshotBuilder (app/Services/Pricing/CompositionSnapshotBuilder.php) and inserted at order creation time by PricingService, OrderService, FrontendOrderService.
composition_snapshot_lifecycle.frontend_contribution: Wizard contributes ONLY item_id / variations / extras / addons via Vue store (legacy POS payload). Backend re-validates and re-prices in PricingService::calculateOrder.
composition_snapshot_lifecycle.immutability_contract: Per CompositionSnapshotBuilder docblock and OrderService comments: composition_snapshot is NEVER re-written after the initial insert. NF525 fiscal SSOT. Reprint flows must read from snapshot, never recompute.
composition_snapshot_lifecycle.concern_zero: Architecture is sound. Pricing SSOT enforced; wizard is correctly subordinated. CLAUDE.md §8 invariants respected.

duplication_with_kiosk_wizard.summary: POS wizard (Vanilla JS) and Kiosk wizard (Vue KioskWizardComponent family) share substantial conceptual scope: viande/sauce/garniture/menu addon step semantics, sauce_frites + grande_portion + cheddar pricing logic, crudités default-included rules. They DO NOT share code today.
shared_concepts: VIANDES catalog list (pos-wizard.js:49-60) vs Kiosk hardcoded list
ALL_SAUCES catalog (pos-wizard.js:65-83) vs Kiosk i18n-keyed list
sauce_frites + frites_grande + frites_cheddar pricing — both surfaces apply same prices via window.POS_WIZARD_CONFIG / kiosk config
composer_profile + composer_aware feature flag — both surfaces eventually converge on admin-defined wizard when flag flips ON
duplication_with_kiosk_wizard.duplication_cost: Maintenance burden when adding new viande/sauce. Today, owner adds via DB admin UI (composer_profile path) but legacy heuristic falls back to hardcoded VIANDES list when composer_aware flag is OFF. Bowl wizard 3-step (Menu V3 cycle 2026-05-14) confirms drift risk when one surface evolves faster than the other.
duplication_with_kiosk_wizard.recommendation_long_term: V1.0.X+ backlog: complete the composer_aware migration (flip flag ON in prod) and deprecate the hardcoded VIANDES + ALL_SAUCES constants in pos-wizard.js. Until then, the duplication is acceptable per CLAUDE.md §3 principle 5 (partial is better than wrong).

known_stale_references.test_debt_from_v1_0_1: Per BRAIN entry 'V1.0.1 Hardening Cycle 2026-05-17', H6 trait fixed 27 POS test debt failures.
